pages.name: Queen's Pawn Game: Chigorin Variation, Anti-Veresov
pages.notes: Overview and plans described a pin on a knight that is not on f3 (2...Bg4 with the g1-knight at home), including plan 1's ...Bxf3 gxf3. Rewrote the overview and all four plans around f3 and e4, and the pin only if White plays Nf3. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn Game: Levitsky Attack
pages.notes: Plan 2 kept a pin on a knight not yet on f6 and played Ne5 with the knight on g1; plan 3 gave ...g5 with White's bishop on g5. Rewrote both. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn Game: Stonewall Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed Qe1-h4 with the king still on e1; plan 2 called White's dark-squared bishop the piece to trade, when the dangerous one is the d3-bishop. Rewrote both. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn Game: Zurich Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave Ng1-e2-f4 with the e2-pawn in the way; plan 2 had Black use the g-file against White's king after 2...Bxg4, when it is White's half-open file. Rewrote both. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: 2.c3 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave Bd3 without e3 and wrote 0-0. Rewrote it. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: 2.c3 Nf6 3.Bf4
pages.notes: Overview called the f4-bishop the light-squared 'problem' bishop; plan 1 used a c3-d4-e3 route; plan 3 sent a knight via h2 with White's h-pawn there; plan 4 offered a ...b5 expansion. Rewrote the overview and plans 1, 3, 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: Veresov Attack
pages.notes: Plan 2 was vague about moving the queen via d2; plan 4 had f3 as a Black move. Rewrote both. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: Veresov, 3.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave Be2/d3 and O-O with the e-pawn blocking the bishop. Rewrote it. British spelling (including less-travelled, memorisation).

pages.name: Siberian Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave a g4-h5 route. Rewrote it as g4 and h4. British spelling.

pages.name: Tautvaisis Defense, BDG
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave Ng5, which the g1-knight cannot reach, and called the f-file open; plan 2 wrote ...0-0. Rewrote both. British spelling.
